hinweis: Plan für bildwerk.bat und einbauen.bat. Alle Texte stehen hier, die Skripte enthalten keine. Keine Zahlen und Prozentzeichen in Prompts.
regeln: Keine Ziffern und kein Prozentzeichen im Prompt: Z-Image malt sie als Schrift ins Bild (aus '80%' wurden %, 0% und 9%).
Keine Wörter, die Schrift nahelegen: 'Hu, the spoken word' ergab einmal den Schriftzug HU.
Ägyptische Merkmale positiv und genau beschreiben (Kopf im Profil, Einlagen aus Lapislazuli): das trägt.
Seltene Wesen kennt das Modell nicht: das Seth-Tier wurde zu Anubis. Lieber über Gegenstände und Wirkung zeigen.
Das Tier zuerst und ausdrücklich nennen: aus 'lioness-goddess sun disc' wurde ein Hund.
Wörter wie square, plaque, tile, coin, medallion locken Tafeln und Rahmen an.
Das Wort für den Hintergrund bestimmt die Helligkeit: 'grey stone' gab hellgrauen Grund, darum immer 'dark ...'.
Hände und Füße bekommen oft vier Finger oder Zehen: verdecken (Bandagen, Sandalen) oder in der Auswahl meiden.
Neue Stile erst als Probe mit gleichem Seed gegen den alten Stil prüfen, dann in die Nacht.
Höchstens etwa ein Megapixel, Entschlüsseln in Kacheln (AMD-Treiber). Etwa drei Minuten je Bild, eine Nacht reicht für gut hundert Bilder.
Lange Prompts kosten Zeit (Text-Encoder auf dem Prozessor): etwa 25 Sekunden mehr je Bild.

Licht nur als Farbe beschreiben: 'moonlight' und 'oil-lamp' werden wörtlich gemalt (Mond und moderne Sturmlaterne in jedem Bild). Kleidung als schlichtes Leinen benennen, sonst kommen Ledergürtel, Schürzen und Strohhüte.

motive.motiv: a huge noble ginger tomcat, a real cat and not a person, with a broad golden collar and a small glowing sun disc floating above his head, wise golden eyes
motive.tex: the ruins of a sun temple

motive.name: Der elfte Ruderer
motive.motiv: a sunburnt muscular oarsman with a plain linen headcloth, the handle of a long oar resting on his shoulder, quiet loyal eyes
motive.tex: the dark deck of a large boat on black water

motive.name: Horus
motive.motiv: the god Horus with the head of a falcon and the body of a strong man, wet from the river, a dripping collar of blue and gold, the falcon eye fierce and bright
motive.tex: a dark river with soft drowned shapes in the water

motive.name: Die mit dem Messer
motive.motiv: a fierce goddess with wild black hair and burning amber eyes, a long flint knife held upright before her face, red glow from below on her face, old burn scars on her shoulders
motive.tex: the glowing edge of a deep fire pit

motive.name: Schu
motive.motiv: the air god Shu as a strong bearded man with a single tall ostrich feather on his head, his bare arms raised at the edge of the picture, wind in his hair
motive.tex: a dawn-blue sky with drifting clouds

motive.name: Wand: sandstein
motive.motiv: large pale sandstone wall blocks with fine joints, light weathering and faint tool marks

motive.name: Wand: granit
motive.motiv: dark grey granite wall blocks with pink speckles, softly worn edges and thin dark joints

motive.name: Wand: lehm
motive.motiv: a sun-dried mud-brick wall with chopped straw in the bricks, uneven plaster patches and fine cracks

motive.name: Wand: grab
motive.motiv: a pale limestone tomb wall with faint traces of painted red and blue bands, flaking plaster and hairline cracks

motive.name: Wand: hoehle
motive.motiv: a rough cave wall of dark violet-grey rock with thin mineral veins and a few small crystals

motive.name: Boden: pflaster
motive.motiv: irregular rounded cobblestones in warm grey and rose tones with sandy joints

motive.name: Boden: gruft
motive.motiv: worn dark limestone floor slabs with fine dust in the joints and faint chisel marks

motive.name: Boden: sand
motive.motiv: fine desert sand in warm beige with soft wind ripples and a few small pebbles

motive.name: Boden: feld
motive.motiv: dry cracked field earth with stubble of cut barley straw and small clods

motive.name: Boden: glas
motive.motiv: a floor of fused desert glass, glassy green-blue sand with fine bubbles and hairline cracks

motive.name: Boden: hoehlenboden
motive.motiv: an uneven dark cave floor of packed grey-violet dust with small stones

motive.name: Fels: fels
motive.motiv: a weathered desert rock face with horizontal layers, deep cracks and warm ochre and grey tones

motive.name: Requisit: ton
motive.motiv: a smooth fired clay surface in terracotta with fine kiln marks and slight unevenness

motive.name: Requisit: holz
motive.motiv: weathered dark wooden planks with visible grain, knots and small cracks

motive.name: Requisit: palmrinde
motive.motiv: rough palm trunk bark with ring-like scars and a fibrous texture

motive.name: Requisit: palmblatt
motive.motiv: a green palm leaf surface with fine parallel veins and a few dry brown tips

motive.name: Requisit: korb
motive.motiv: a tight weave of golden brown reed straw as in a basket

motive.name: Mahaf, das Leitlicht
motive.motiv: a ghostly ferryman of the dead made of pale turquoise light, an old man with a long pole over his shoulder, his body fading into glowing mist
motive.tex: dark water and a drifting empty boat

motive.name: Die Mutter der Häute
motive.motiv: a giant serpent mother with many shed skins hanging from her body like torn veils, golden scales, a cold reptile gaze
motive.tex: a field of broken barley stalks

motive.name: Der König ohne Namen
motive.motiv: a mummified pharaoh king in blackened gold, his face hidden by a cracked golden mask with the name chiselled away, holding a golden sword
motive.tex: a dark royal tomb with smashed hieroglyphs

motive.name: Der Stumme Türhüter
motive.motiv: a towering grey stone gate guardian with the head of a jackal, a sealed mouth, a golden collar and dim glowing eyes
motive.tex: a massive dark gate

motive.name: Der Sammler
motive.motiv: a gaunt old judge of the dead in a long purple robe, surrounded by many small clay jars that glow from inside, a cold proud face
motive.tex: a vast cave full of jars

motive.name: Der falsche Osiris
motive.motiv: a false Osiris lying in state rising from a bier, green skin, white crown and crook and flail, but his eyes are empty and black
motive.tex: a dark burial chamber

motive.name: Eine Windung des Apophis
motive.motiv: a giant serpent, one enormous coil of a black and red snake rising out of a sandbank, its head lowered and its mouth open
motive.tex: a dry riverbed at night

motive.name: Der Hüter ohne Stimme
motive.motiv: a bandaged guardian of the tombs of the gods, a tall figure wrapped in old linen with a golden ram mask, its mouth bound shut
motive.tex: rows of dark tomb doors

motive.name: Erster Akt: Der Abstieg
motive.motiv: a lone figure with a small lantern descending a long stone stair into a dark desert valley, faint glowing souls drift like lights down into the valley
motive.tex: deep night blue and warm amber colors

motive.name: Zweiter Akt: Die Wahrheit
motive.motiv: a giant golden balance scale in a vast dark hall of columns, a heart on one pan and an ostrich feather on the other, a jackal-headed god standing beside it
motive.tex: deep night blue and gold colors

motive.name: Dritter Akt: Der Morgen
motive.motiv: the golden boat of the sun gliding through a great eastern gate towards the horizon, a giant scarab beetle lifting a red sun disc above it
motive.tex: pale rose, gold and deep blue colors of first dawn

motive.name: Sand: Rippel
motive.motiv: pale desert sand with fine wind ripples running in gently varied curves, evenly lit, no objects, no footprints, no insects

motive.name: Sand: glatt
motive.motiv: smooth pale desert sand with very faint shallow ripples and a few scattered tiny pebbles, evenly lit, no objects, no footprints, no insects

einbau.hinweis: Je Symbol: Quelle unter ComfyUI\output ohne _00001_.png. Nach dem Lauf symbole_neu kannst du bei den sieben neu gerechneten Symbolen auf bildwerk/symbole_neu/<id>_aegypt_<a-d> umstellen. zoom < 1 schneidet enger zu (Rand und Boden weg).
einbau.hinweis_portraets: Porträts: Code (P04 usw.) -> Quelle. Die Figuren aus portraets_figuren sind ein Übergang (Mond und Laterne im Bild); portraets_figuren_nah soll sie ersetzen. portraet_zuschnitt: {code oder standard: {zoom, oben}}, zoom kleiner = enger.
einbau.hinweis_texturen: Texturen: Name der Spieldatei (z. B. t06_pflaster) -> Quelle (z. B. bildwerk/texturen_neu/t06_pflaster_textur_a). einbauen.bat texturen gleicht die Helligkeit aus, glättet die Kachelnaht und erzeugt die Normalenkarte (_n), Ergebnis nach textures/.
